[EN] I never thought that something like this could happen.

Our resolution must not waver!
[ES] Nunca pensé que algo así pudiera pasar.

¡Nuestra resolución no debe flaquear!

[EN] The time has come to put an end to Samael's treachery. He's betrayed everything we've fought for and put the entire federation at risk. Are you ready?"On my honor, it won't.""We'll take him together..."
[ES] Ha llegado el momento de poner fin a la traición de Samael. Ha traicionado todo por lo que hemos luchado y puesto en riesgo a toda la federación. ¿Estás listo?"On my honor, it won't.""We'll take him together..."

[EN] General... How could you...
[ES] General... Cómo pudiste...
